status: PRIMARY-SOURCE RULES AND RECIPIENT REPLACEMENT PATH REVIEWED; no legal/applicability decision; release remains blocked

officialSources.title: WebKit Licensing documentation
officialSources.finding: WebKit says inherited KHTML code may be LGPL, new contributions use BSD-2-Clause, and moved files keep their original copyright/license.

officialSources.title: GNU LGPL FAQ
officialSources.finding: Duties depend on the exact LGPL version and link/distribution mode; conveying an LGPL library with an application involves source obligations, while static linking raises relinkable object-code concerns.

officialSources.title: GNU LGPL 2.1 text
officialSources.finding: Exact source-bundle and replacement/relink duties must be derived from the actual covered files and mode; including a license text alone is not the entire compliance proof.

officialSources.title: MPL 2.0 text
officialSources.finding: Executable distribution requires corresponding source and recipient notice of how to obtain it under section 3.2; preserve source notices.

findings.perFileTerms: Consistent with upstream WebKit guidance: no image-wide BSD/LGPL inference; existing per-file and generated-source maps are the correct decision unit.
findings.runtimePin: Host attestation verifies the exact owned WebKit binary SHA-256 from its signed helper pin and refuses a different loaded WebKit image.
findings.recipientSigner: Host code identity derives expected Team ID from the signed manager; source comment explicitly says consistently re-signed recipient relink copies are intended to work. The recipient re-sign tool signs the complete copied Frameworks tree; the host packager has a separate --recipient-relink route.
findings.existingEvidence: A clean relocated build/relink exists on this Mac but output binaries differ from the shipped candidate; no end-to-end recipient-signed replacement launch has been evidenced. The draft offer itself says it is partial and not a complete corresponding-source/relink offer.
findings.worksheet: No worksheet field is changed; all 82 UNKNOWN decisions remain.

decision: Continue only after a complete exact per-file/license and notice mapping is bound to a future app, and the existing recipient route is verified end-to-end with a separately signed copy. Do not classify text inclusion or the re-sign code path alone as LGPL/MPL replacement compliance.
limitations: This is technical release review, not a legal opinion.
The exact LGPL alternatives/versions and Apache NOTICE obligations must be resolved per linked source/third-party record.
